pages.text: Fit a cabinet by using the side below the driver’s seat. Both wagon forms support installation, and its width adapts to the seat.$(br2)A single seat provides single-chest capacity. Two- and three-seat benches both provide double-chest capacity; the wider cabinet adds no extra slots.

Use either handled end to open a drawer, even while holding an item. It slides out and returns when the menu closes. Sneak-use to remove the cabinet; contents drop separately.$(br2)Conversion preserves storage. Breaking a block-form seat drops the seat, cabinet and contents separately. Hammer dismantling also recovers the cabinet.

pages.heading: book.tm_wagon.recipe
pages.text: Use six matching planks around a barrel. The planks determine the cabinet’s wood.
